VSP_as_Fan.title: Use Fan for Variable Speed Pumps
VSP_as_Fan.description: Pumps are switches by default, using Fan allows for RPM change (Using %)

user_device_deg_C.title: Display devices are DegC
user_device_deg_C.description: For external sensors that are NOT temperature sensors, a temperature sensor will be created due to homekit limitations. This will correct the value displayed if your device is set to show degC

no_delete_on_sync.title: No delete on sync
no_delete_on_sync.description: Do not delete accessories when syncing

items.helpvalue:
Exclude Devices
To prevent certain aqualinkd devices from showing up in Homebridge, add the name of the device.
Visit http://aqualinkd_server_ip/api/devices to see all available IDs.
